name: Warcaller Gorlach
summary: Across Orgrimmar, Warcaller Gorlach calls Horde champions to distant battlefronts. He rallies travelers and seasoned warriors to answer commands at outposts across Kalimdor and beyond.

sections.title: Voice of the Warchief's Call
sections.body: Warcaller Gorlach walks Orgrimmar's thoroughfares with the Horde's calls for expansion and defense. Among the city's people, he seeks volunteers ready to test their mettle. He sends some to contested Ashenvale. Others he directs to Camp Mojache in Feralas, where scouts face the wilderness. He calls warriors to campaigns in the distant Plaguelands as threats rise abroad.

faq.answer: Warcaller Gorlach patrols Orgrimmar as an orc herald. He directs Horde members toward combat zones and remote frontiers.

faq.q: Where does Warcaller Gorlach send adventurers?
faq.answer: Warcaller Gorlach directs Horde champions to outposts in need. These include Ashenvale, Camp Mojache in Feralas, and distant fronts such as the Plaguelands.

faq.q: Where can Warcaller Gorlach be found?
faq.answer: Warcaller Gorlach patrols Orgrimmar's streets and valleys, calling its people to arms.

angles.text: As a Horde champion seeking to prove your strength or find guidance beyond Durotar, you can turn to Gorlach. He directs you toward outposts in need of reinforcements.
